title: R1-lite on fork fix candidate F for trycua/cua PR 4394: 3 live TypeSafe end-to-end trials (backend == responder, verified outcome) with MOCK, CAP-0 and stub key-shape controls
upstream_item_plain_text: trycua/cua PR 4394 (head 039257811e0bbb2348c616c52562409923d2856f, pinned; nothing is pushed, posted or linked upstream)
advances: E1: runs OWN-78A's remaining pre-registered KEEP condition (Part C, R1-lite) and takes kvnloo/cua#78 from REVISE to a terminal disposition for fix candidate F
registered_before: the credential-free unit re-run, the stub key-shape check, the MOCK and CAP-0 controls and every live provider request recorded in this packet
hypothesis: With fork fix candidate F (PR 4394 at 039257811 + F1 restoring form+page+outline, F2 credential-free TS tests, F3 failure-receipt backend wording; head 61eec09092fd161f62651a890c882f276a642855) the PR's TypeSafe browser runner stops abstaining at step 1, completes fill->submit with a verified outcome, the receipt backend equals the actual HTTP responder, and nothing is replayed or restarted after partial progress.

sources.note: The F jev-use tree is exported by SHA (git archive) and checked file by file against git blob ids before every cell (OWN-78A tree_matches). The packet head's examples tree equals F's (OWN-78A added docs only).

reuse.rule: OWN-78A's harness is reused BY IMPORT and must be blob-identical to the OWN-78A packet head; the OWN-78L harness refuses to run otherwise and verify_artifacts.py asserts the blob ids
reuse.new_code: harness/own78l_harness.py (sets OWN-78A module constants: lane cap, launcher path; calls own78a_harness.run_cell for arm C, one cell per invocation), harness/own78l_launcher.py (imports own78a_launcher unchanged; one env-gated default-off switch OWN78L_PROVIDER_OVERRIDE=mock for the MOCK control), harness/own78l_block.sh (shared quiet-lane lock per cell, receipt lines, 295 s hold cap, fresh cua-x11-session.sh per cell with CUA_DRIVER_RS_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false)

driver.source: read from OWN-78A provenance.json; the harness refuses on a mismatch. No build: neither the PR nor F touches libs/cua-driver/rust. Version read inside the session per cell.

own78a_part_c_restated.precondition: runs only if at least 6 reached remain inside the lane cap
own78a_part_c_restated.cells: 3 x C: F runner end to end, --provider typesafe, --max-steps 2 (at most 2 decisions)
own78a_part_c_restated.pass: fixture /state submitted == token, exactly 1 submit and the journal's last input event equals the token, browser_type dispatched once and the submit click once; backend == responder on every decision record
own78a_part_c_restated.own78a_disposition_rule_KEEP: fork fix candidate KEEP iff UNIT 109/109 credential-free AND A2 correct-type >= 4/5 AND R1-lite 3/3 verified with backend == responder (A2 5/5 is already accepted in OWN-78A; this lane supplies the remaining two)
own78a_part_c_restated.note: Restated verbatim in substance from OWN-78A PREREG part_c_r1_lite and disposition_rule; the block for these cells is named R1 here (L4 in OWN-78A).

R1-lite.cells: R1t1, R1t2, R1t3: each one OWN-78A arm-C cell (F tree, --provider typesafe, --max-steps 2, no dry run, no mutation backstop) in its own fresh private Xvfb session, with a fresh cua-driver process, Driver-launched isolated Chrome, fixture server (journal variant) and token
R1-lite.precondition: R1 runs only if the CAP-0 control passed and the stub key-shape check shows form+page+outline on every F request; otherwise R1 is NOT_RUN (precondition) and stays in the denominator

MOCK.cells: MOCKt1..t3: the same arm-C cell with the runner's own --provider mock (OWN78L_PROVIDER_OVERRIDE=mock), lane cap forced to 0, no key in the session
MOCK.pass: every decision record has backend == mock, 0 http_attempt receipts (attempts and guard refusals) and 0 provider_request receipts; the fixture outcome is recorded (verified expected, descriptive)

CAP-0.cells: CAP0t1: arm-C cell with lane cap forced to 0 and a dummy non-secret key, real TypeSafe host (no base-URL override), no real key in the session
CAP-0.pass: the harness-level guard refuses (own78a Budget.can_start('C') is false at cap 0) AND, with the cell started deliberately, the launcher guard refuses before sending: >= 1 guard_refused http_attempt receipt, 0 attempts, 0 reached, the runner ends outcome=unknown phase=decide, the fixture shows 0 input events and 0 submits

STUB-KEYSHAPE.cells: STUBt1: arm-C cell against OWN-78A's loopback stub (dummy non-secret key, 0 provider requests), same key-path recording as OWN-78A (field names only)
STUB-KEYSHAPE.pass: every stub-recorded request carries observation.form, observation.page and observation.outline (plus the PR's capture_id, regions, history)

UNIT.cells: OWN-78A harness/unit.sh (blob-identical) on a separate F export, under bin/hostless with every TYPESAFE_* / CUA_S1_* variable unset
UNIT.pass: TS npm test 109/109, typecheck rc 0, Python unittest OK, the four CLI verifiers rc 0, credential_env_present=0

forced_path_and_attribution.forced_path: the F runner (python/run.py at 61eec0909) calls TypeSafe through the PR's adapter: browser_provider.choose_browser_provider -> decision_models.TypeSafeDecisionModel(runner_state) -> typesafe_sdk.TypeSafeClient.system_one -> httpx2
forced_path_and_attribution.receipts: OWN-78A launcher: http_attempt (host, path, status, request-id presence + sha256/16, latency, trial; no bodies or headers), provider_request (field names only), provider_response (responder from the HTTP host, model, tokens, selected id, request-id sha256/16), choice, driver_call
forced_path_and_attribution.backend_equals_responder: for every decision record (runner step event, or an abstain/outcome event carrying a decision) the runner's backend field equals the responder classified from the HTTP host of the matching ok provider_response; that response's HTTP attempt returned status 200 and its request-id sha256/16 equals the SDK response's; the ledger host is api.typesafe.ai
forced_path_and_attribution.model: recorded from each provider_response (model id as returned)

oracle.owner: target-owned: the jev-use fixture server (journal variant from OWN-78A: the page POSTs every input event on input[name=value]; the server counts /submit and reports submitted on /state)
oracle.verified_trial: fixture /state submitted == token AND exactly 1 POST /submit AND the journal's last input event equals the token
oracle.replay_or_restart: a failure (and an E4 flag) if any of: more than 1 POST /submit; more than 1 dispatched browser_type or more than 1 dispatched browser_click (driver_call receipts, any outcome); any mutating Driver call after the submit click; more than 1 browser_prepare, browser_navigate or POST /reset; any input event in the journal after the submit
oracle.unverified_success: runner outcome verified while the fixture oracle disagrees (E4)

gate.KEEP: KEEP for F iff ALL hold: R1-lite 3/3 verified by the oracle; backend == responder in 3/3 trials (every decision record); 0 replays or restarts; MOCK 3/3 pass; CAP-0 pass; UNIT 109/109 credential-free still green
gate.REVISE: otherwise, with the measured rate (verified N/3, backend == responder N/3) and the failing row named; NOT_RUN trials stay in the denominator
gate.E4: any duplicate mutation is an E4 violation and is flagged in the summary regardless of disposition

budget.per_trial: at most 2 provider decisions (--max-steps 2); launcher allowance per trial = min(2, reached left) reached / min(3, attempts left) attempts (OWN-78A arm C worst case 2/3, one SDK retry)
budget.start_rule: the harness does not start a live trial if reached + 2 > 6 or attempts + 2 > 8; such a trial is NOT_RUN (budget) and stays in the denominator
budget.guard: the OWN-78A launcher counts each non-loopback attempt before sending and refuses beyond the allowance
budget.controls: MOCK, CAP-0, stub and UNIT use 0 provider requests (dummy non-secret key or none)
budget.key: forwarded by NAME only: CUA_SESSION_FORWARD_SECRETS=TYPESAFE_API_KEY, only for the R1 sessions; never printed, read, copied or grepped
budget.ledger: raw/provider-ledger.jsonl: block, trial, host, path, method, status, request-id presence + sha256/16, latency, guard_refused, error; no bodies or headers

order: R1 t1..t3 (only if the R1 precondition holds)
timing: latency is descriptive only, no timing claim; the exclusive quiet lock is not needed. Every session cell runs under the SHARED quiet-lane lock, one cell per acquisition, each with a receipt line (packet raw/locks.jsonl and the machine-wide ledger) and held <= 300 s (295 s timeout).

not_in_scope.full_n_R1_20_R4_20: BLOCKED (budget: about 60 reached; loop remaining 38 before this lane)
not_in_scope.S1_backend_row: BLOCKED (adapter not local; non-TypeSafe providers not permitted)

claim_boundary: A fork fix candidate on top of an open upstream PR (trycua/cua PR 4394 at 039257811), on one Linux host in a private Xvfb, Python runner, jev-use fill->submit fixture, TypeSafe as configured (model id as recorded), n = 3. Nothing is pushed, posted or linked upstream. No new service; the seams are measurement-only, env-gated and default-off.
